name: Medical X-ray projection imaging
summary: Within weeks of the discovery of X-rays, doctors shone them through patients to locate bullets and other hidden objects before removing them.
description: Diagnostic projection imaging using X-rays transmitted through a patient to reveal structures or foreign objects.

why: Rontgen's announcement of X-rays at the end of 1895 gave doctors a way to see inside the body without cutting.
